explanation: The evidence contains no data on itraconazole increasing palbociclib AUC by ~87%; only a rifampin-induced 85% decrease in exposure is documented. This specific inhibitor study result is fabricated.
suggested_rewrite: Remove the itraconazole ~87% AUC claim; state only that strong CYP3A inhibitors substantially increase palbociclib exposure, per label guidance, without citing an unverified specific percentage.
